title: Super Bowl XXX
overview: Super Bowl XXX, played on January 28, 1996, at Sun Devil Stadium in Tempe, Arizona, was a historic showdown between the Dallas Cowboys and the Pittsburgh Steelers. The Cowboys emerged victorious with a 27-17 win, securing their third Super Bowl title in four years and tying the Steelers and 49ers for the most Super Bowl victories at the time, with five. The game also marked the return of one of the NFL’s most classic rivalries, as Dallas and Pittsburgh met in the Super Bowl for the third time, with the Steelers having won their previous matchups in the 1970s.
